Question Choices: Fill: A quadrilateral has __ sides, __ angles, __ vertices (corners).
Solution: 4,4,4. A quadrilateral is any closed 2D shape that has four straight sides, which means it also has four corners (vertices) and four angles.

Question Choices: A quadrilateral has one interior angle greater than 180°. Is it concave or convex?
Hints: Think about whether the shape looks like it “caves in.”
Solution: Concave|concave. A concave quadrilateral has at least one interior angle greater than 180°, making the shape look like it bends inward.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides. What is this shape called? : Parallelogram Trapezoid Rectangle Rhombus
Solution: Trapezoid. A trapezoid has exactly one pair of parallel sides. A parallelogram has two pairs of opposite sides that are parallel.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A shape has 4 sides and 2 pairs of parallel sides. What is the most specific name for this shape? : Parallelogram Trapezoid
Solution: Parallelogram. Having two pairs of parallel sides means the shape is a parallelogram.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral is a parallelogram and has four right angles but length of sides are not all equal. What is it called? : Rectangle Square Rhombus
Hints: Be careful, we are not sure about the length of sides of this shape
Solution: Rectangle. A rectangle is a parallelogram with four 90° angles.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has all sides the same length and opposite sides parallel but angles are not all right angles. What is it called? : Rectangle Square Rhombus
Hints: All angles of a square are right angles
Solution: Rhombus. A rhombus is a parallelogram where all four sides are equal, even if the angles are not right angles.

Question Choices: A quadrilateral has four right angles and all sides equal. Is this a square? Answer yes or no
Is every rectangle a parallelogram? Answer yes or no
Hints: A parallelogram has two pairs of opposite sides that are parallel.
Solution: yes|Yes. A rectangle has two pairs of parallel sides, so every rectangle is a parallelogram.

Hints: A rectangle has exactly 4 right angles
Solution: no|No. Some parallelograms do not have four right angles, so they are not rectangles.

Question Choices: Select the correct option. A quadrilateral has four right angles and all sides equal. This shape belongs to which of the following families? : Rectangle Square Rhombus All-above
Hints: It belongs to many shape families.
Solution: All-above. A square is both a rectangle (four right angles) and a rhombus (four equal sides)
